242:t_1:59.en:
$n
「I don't know how that mysterious space, the black $$アンゲロイ$$... and the Angel I've been chasing are connected...」

242:t_1:60.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If the bloodstained eyes still appear, does that mean $$ガドライト#pilot$$ wasn't the one who killed your family, $n...?」

242:t_1:61.en:
$n
「I'd half expected it... In my mind, $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the Angel weren't unrelated, but I felt a distance between them somehow.」

242:t_1:62.en:
$n
「My bloodstained eyes appeared in $$ラース・バビロン$$, too. The Angel and $$サイデリアル$$ must be connected, but I have no way to investigate it now...」

242:t_1:64.en:
$n
「I'm sorry I worried you. But... I'm all right.」

242:t_1:66.en:
$n
「I've managed somehow all this time. That won't change.」

242:t_1:68.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But... Fighting in that space, I feel like I understood a little about your bloodstained eyes, $n.」

242:t_1:69.en:
$$甲児$$
「Me, too. ...You've always been fighting with that feeling, haven't you?」

242:t_1:71.en:
$n
「But even I managed to get through it. I'm sure you guys won't let it crush you.」

242:t_1:72.en:
$$アルト$$
「Look at you. No wonder you were the first of us to stop being the quiet type.」

242:t_1:73.en:
$n
「Shut up, king of the female roles.」

242:t_1:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「After giving $n all that high-and-mighty advice, we'd better live up to it ourselves.」

242:t_1:75.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Anyway, if he says we don't need to worry, then everything's fine now.」

242:t_1:77.en:
$$ハサン$$
「That's fine, but shouldn't you say something to Miss $$スズネ$$ first?」

242:t_1:80.en:
$n
「I-I'm sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$! I... didn't know you'd stayed with me...!」

242:t_1:81.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't worry about it. Just take care of yourself.」

242:t_1:84.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is this a repeat of what happened during the $$時獄戦役$$...?」

242:t_1:85.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Things have been rough ever since the attack on $$ラース・バビロン$$, but...」

242:t_1:86.en:
$n
「...Still, we've got a way to return to Earth now.」

242:t_1:87.en:
$$アルト$$
「From Jupiter, a few Folds will get us back to the Earth Sphere.」

242:t_1:88.en:
$$甲児$$
「It sounds strange to thank being sent to the galactic center, but we did learn about the universe's collapse.」

242:t_1:89.en:
$$シン$$
「And we learned about $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card, too.」

242:t_1:90.en:
$n
「We'll return to Earth and pay back the $$新地球皇国$$.」

242:t_1:92.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've got plenty to do. There's no time to let despair or fear beat us.」

242:t_1:94.en:
$n
(Hang on, $$宗介$$... We'll be back on Earth soon.)

242:t_1:95.en:
$n
(I believe you and the others are safe...)

242:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A beautiful woman's troubled face has quite a charm, $$セツコ$$.」

242:t_10:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm sorry. I'm not up to joking around.」

242:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you've taken my once-in-a-lifetime declaration as a joke, too.」

242:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That mysterious space is still troubling you, I see.」

242:t_10:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The woman who appeared at the end... She spoke to me through my $$スフィア$$.」

242:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A mystery is a mystery. You can agonize over it here, but you won't get beyond speculation.」

242:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Personally, I'm happier that you wiped out that terrifying army.」

242:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... got so carried away that I generated 100Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$ myself. I've added them to the team's stock, of course.」

242:t_10:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Whatever happens, you're always devoted to $$Ｚチップ$$, $$ＡＧ$$.」

242:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! That's what being a dimensional merchant means!」

242:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... And that is our very last hope.)

242:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your bloodstained eyes are troubling you, I see.」

242:t_10:23.en:
$n
「It's just as I told $$アルト$$ and the others. There's nothing I can figure out at this point...」

242:t_10:24.en:
$n
「So I'll just deal with what's in front of me, one thing at a time.」

242:t_10:26.en:
$n
「I can handle my own problems myself. The trouble is...」

242:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not sure... You're no longer the troublesome student you used to be...」

242:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perhaps you could fill the emptiness in her heart... as a man!」

242:t_10:31.en:
$n
「I was an idiot to ask you.」

242:t_10:33.en:
$n
「If I stay here, you'll probably make me mind $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

242:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He finds hope in any despair... How endearing the $$いがみ合う双子$$ are.」

242:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It depends on the person. $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ drew out his $$スフィア$$'s power through anger and resignation.」

242:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't care about a dead man. What matters is what happens next.」

242:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everything has begun to move... Toward the true collapse that comes every 120 million years...」

242:t_10:43.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Will our return to Earth mark the beginning of the end...?」

242:t_10:45.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Keep working hard at your business until then.」

242:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! Now, let's get down to business again today!」
